question: Which of the following word is the ANTONYM of the word 'distrustful' used in the passage?
solution:
The correct answer is "Ingenuous."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let us understand the meaning of the given and the marked words:
 
 
• "Distrustful" means to have no trust or confidence in something.

 
 
• Example: I was distrustful of his motives.
 
 
 
• "Ingenuous" means honest, innocent and willing to trust people in a way that sometimes seems foolish.
 
 
• Example: He seemed too ingenuous for a journalist.
 
 
 
 
 
• From the above explanation, it is clear that the word "ingenuous" is the antonym of the word "distrustful."
 
• Hence, the correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• Let us understand the meanings of the other given words:
 
 
• "Cynical" means not trusting or respecting the goodness of other people and their actions.
 
• "Leery" means being cautious or wary due to realistic suspicions.
 
• "Cautious" means taking great care to avoid possible danger or problems.
